readerCopy.body: A present act of freedom can still be organized around an old person, rule, or humiliation. Lilith square the South Node can turn a justified refusal into another round of the same conflict if proving you cannot be controlled becomes more important than the result you actually want. You may speak up, quit, expose the problem, or reject the role partly to reverse an earlier outcome. Reclamation matters. It becomes freer when the past stops choosing the target.
